The top and bottom lines are parallel. The angle between the top horizontal line (extending left) and \(AB\) is \(124^\circ\), so the angle between the top horizontal line (extending right) and \(AB\) is \(180^\circ - 124^\circ = 56^\circ\). By alternate interior angles, the interior angle at \(B\) is \(124^\circ\). The angle between the top horizontal line (extending right) and \(AC\) is \(x^\circ\), so the interior angle at \(C\) is \(x^\circ\). The interior angle at \(A\) is \(56^\circ - x^\circ\).

Given \(AB = BC\), the angles opposite these sides are equal: \(\angle C = \angle A\). Thus,
\[x = 56 - x\]
\[2x = 56\]
\[x = 28\]

Answer: 28
